$comment: Slots of sections/stage.ts (one plate, three states of the Session object; staging v5/sections/hero-stage/NOTES.md has the slot table with lines at 1440 / 390). steps[k].tag: the step tag at the plate's top-left (Inter 500 15px; pinned, the past tags shrink to 13px in one row). steps[k].title + steps[k].line: the caption at the plate's bottom-left (Inter 500 22px + Inter 16px, max 560 wide: one line each at 1440; phones 18 / 15px, title 1-2 lines, line 2 lines). kit: the props of the kit Session (src/home/kit renderSession) per state. kit.call.instruction is the first screen's sentence: at most 6 words (first-screen object words = keycap words + Call's words <= 16); it sits on one line and runs off the plate's edge from about 58 characters at 1440. Budgets: tests/home-copy-slots.test.mjs (object words <= 14 per state; zh / ja full-width widths). Sources of every claim: staging v5/content/NOTES.md.

$source.story: One CSV Session, values only from MAIN scripts/public-api-session-workflow.ts: the attached input.csv (L24, L85), outputs/report.md (L24), the follow-up that appends south,20 to the same CSV without recreating it (L33). The call: POST /api/v2/projects/{projectId}/threads (docs/prd/public-thread-api-surface.md L8; OpenAPI v2 path + servers https://cloud.mosoo.ai/api/v2; the script posts to /projects/{id}/threads on an /api/v2 base, L60, L97). Events: SSE and saved history (SPEC §6 L73).
$source.kit.harness: Product name (README L9 'OpenAI Codex'; the chip draws the OpenAI mark before it); not translated.
$source.kit.watch.events: Plain words for three public event types, newest first: file.changed, tool.use.completed, run.started (MAIN pkgs/contracts/src/session/session.contract.ts L141, L148, L144; stage.ts EVENTS keeps the wire names as data).
$source.kit.return: Turn 2 = the follow-up turn; +7 days is SPEC's own example of a later reply (SPEC §4 L53: one minute or seven days, same semantics), not a measured duration; restored from the last committed checkpoint (SPEC §4 L46, L53).
